source:
@@U04580@@
Come on, you shambling gaggle of
misbegotten, half-alive lemurs!

@@U04582@@
(In chorus.)

@@U04583@@
Here we are at your command;
We've half heard why we came. It
Is all about a stretch of land,
And we are here to claim it.
Stakes sharp pointed we have here,
Long chains to measure sections.
But why you called us, sir, we fear,
Has fled our recollections.

@@U04585@@
This job will need no artist.
Use yourselves as measuring rods.
The tallest of you stretch out on the grass,
the rest mark out his shape, then
dig a hole,
long and deep,
the same as was done for our forebears.
From palace to narrow abode;
it always arrives at the same stupid ending.

@@U04587@@
(Digging away with mocking gestures.)

@@U04588@@
In youth when I did live, did love,
I thought it very sweet;
Where mirth was free, and jollity,
That place for me was meet.
But old Age with his stealing steps
Clawed me with his crutch.
I stumbled, tumbled in the grave
Why must they open such?

@@U04589@@
(Enter 浮士德 from the palace, groping along the doorposts.)
translation:
@@U04580@@
来吧，你们这群蹒跚的家伙
误生的、半死不活的狐猴！

@@U04582@@
（齐声）

@@U04583@@
我们听从您的指挥；
我们来的原因已经听了一半了。它
都是关于一片土地，
我们来这里是为了认领它。
我们这里有锋利的木桩，
用于测量截面的长链。
但为什么你打电话给我们，先生，我们担心，
已经逃离我们的记忆。

@@U04585@@
这项工作不需要艺术家。
用你自己作为测量杆。
你们中最高的一个伸展在草地上，
其余的标出他的形状，然后
挖一个洞，
又长又深，
与我们的祖先所做的一样。
从宫殿到狭窄的住所；
它总是到达同样愚蠢的结局。

@@U04587@@
（用嘲笑的手势挖下去。）

@@U04588@@
年轻时我曾生活过、爱过，
我觉得很甜蜜；
那里充满了自由和快乐，
那个地方对我来说就是满足。
但年老时却步履蹒跚
他用拐杖抓我。
我跌倒了，跌倒在坟墓里
为什么他们必须打开这样的？

@@U04589@@
（浮士德从宫中上，摸索着门柱。）
